metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Dark synthwave × glitch-rap × cinematic minimalism. 90 BPM, half‑time backbone with subtle triplet hats in verses. Deep sub pulse, analog bass growl, glassy arps, tape warble, choir fragments reversed into texture, sharp percussive clicks like camera shutters.

**Structure:** Static intro → Verse 1 (tight cadence) → Pre (riser) → Hook (anthemic but controlled) → Verse 2 (denser flow) → Bridge (near-silence + whisper) → Final Hook (brighter top layer) → Outro (heartbeat + shutter clicks).

**Vocals:** Spoken-rap clarity with occasional melodic lift on key lines. Japanese response lines (short, sharp). No preaching tone—measured, surgical, grounded.

**Mood:** Surgical clarity. Calm power. Perception widening without losing center.
metadata.prompt:
## INTRO — Static & Shutter

*(camera shutter clicks / low sub heartbeat)*

click.

another angle.

枠をずらせ。

## VERSE 1 — The Lens

Everybody arguing inside a box
calling it sky, calling it rocks

Frames stacked on frames like Russian dolls
no one asking who built the walls

Facts on the table—
ink still wet
Interpretation—
shadow cast

Narrative—
the mask we wear

But the mask isn’t air.

## PRE‑CHORUS — Reframe

*(riser + metallic ticks)*

Tilt the camera.
Step back.

Choose your axis.
Don’t react.

反応するな
観察しろ

## HOOK — Frame Shifter

*(controlled drop; sub + bright arp)*

I’m a **frame shifter**
not a storm chaser

Name the lens
then step through the laser

Evidence first
then the story

枠をずらせ
still hold your glory

I’m a **frame shifter**
hands still mine

Perception sharp
but autonomy fine

## VERSE 2 — Bullshit Detector

Bullshit’s loud but it’s structurally weak
volume up when the footing’s bleak

If it can’t survive a single “why”
it wasn’t built to clarify

Redteam the thought
before it nests

Mirror the motive
stress-test the text

笑ってから
刺せ

Cut clean, not cruel

Precision is fuel.

## BRIDGE — Quiet Room

*(beat drops; piano two notes; whisper layer)*

You don’t have to believe every feeling.
You don’t have to fight every frame.

呼吸して

Notice the lens.

Change it.

## FINAL HOOK — Widened Sky

*(beat returns bigger; subtle choir lift)*

I’m a **frame shifter**
no panic in sight

Wonder intact
in the edge of the light

Evidence first
then the story

枠をずらせ
write your own glory

I’m a **frame shifter**
steady and free

No one gets to think
inside of me.

## OUTRO — Click

*(heartbeat fades; single shutter)*

click.
